Hey guys,

 

So this year, my boyfriend and I are finally going to be cosplaying! We've wanted to for a couple years now but never found the time to do it.

Here are the characters we'll (hopefully) be cosplaying as:

Jubilee

Cyclops

Jayce (genderbender)

Vi (genderbender)

Setback

Expatriette

 

We've already got some ideas for the xmen and league of legends characters' wardrobe (trying not to buy too many clothes, although I did find a yellow trenchcoat and some oxford shoes).

 

Was wondering if you guys have any tips or ideas that could help us! Especially with constructing the league of legends weapons =P

posts.cooked:
The majority of my knowledge of League of Legends is "Man, those guys were so loud, almost every volunteer in the PAX Australia GTG booth lost their voice"

As far as props go, many people use foam or hardened paper, so as to keep them light (you don't want to be carrying something heavy around all con)

Also, http://cosplaying-on-a-budget.tumblr.com/ is where a lot of people submit instructions on how to make various costumes and props.
